title: ridleyandra violacea

This plant has been traditionally used in Southeast Asia to support cardiovascular health and has been found to have potential health benefits, including lowering blood pressure and improving lipid profiles. The therapeutic actions of Ridleyandra violacea include vasodilation and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its potential benefits in cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as ridleyanoside and 19-O-beta-D-glucopyranosyl-11beta-Hydroxy-6,7-dihydroxy-3,4-dihydrophenanthrene, which have been identified as the primary active compounds responsible for its pharmacological effects.
